name: Kanbara Tooru
source:
This spring, he will begin living alone in order to attend a university in a city far from his parents' home.

He is not as smart as others, but he has more physical strength than others. He is usually a slacker, but once he sets his sights on a goal, he will go for it. His mother, Chihiro, describes him as “fairly good-looking” in her greedy eyes.

He is usually averse to his mother's frequent complaints, but deep down he is grateful for her deep love and affection, and the relationship between father and son is good.

Naturally, as a boy of his age, he has a strong interest in sex, but he has neither the chance nor the courage to try it, and he is still a virgin.

[From [url=http://www.cattleyasoft.com/cat11/character.html]official site[/url]]
